caption: Cost Observation
description: A reported cost or billing quantity with its scope, basis and source: a monetary total with its currency, or a non-monetary billing quantity (premium requests, a model cost multiplier, nano-AIU, credits) with its quantity kind and unit. Quantities of different kinds are never added together or read as money. Present only when a source reported one.
name: cost_observation

currency.description: The ISO 4217 currency of a monetary amount; absent for a billing quantity that is not money.

data.description: The native cost-bearing value or object exactly as reported.
